patch_description: Replace the uniformly random square sample with a deterministic multi-start simulated-annealing search inside a fixed unit-area-affine triangular hull. The three hull vertices are retained permanently, so every generated point is guaranteed to lie in a convex region and the hull normalization is fixed. The objective evaluates all 286 triangle determinants directly, while progressively smaller projected perturbations refine the bottleneck triangle area. Multiple seeded restarts and occasional larger moves provide substantially better coverage than a single random arrangement while remaining reproducible and lightweight for only 13 points.
